responsibility: Implements type checking for items inside impl and extern blocks. It resolves extern statics and functions into TyTy types, type-checks inherent impl methods/constants/type aliases with generic parameter handling and body checking, and separately validates trait-impl items by matching each impl member to the corresponding trait item, merging inherited attributes, checking signature or type compatibility, and creating projection types for associated type implementations.
same_name_distinction: Provides the implementations for impl/extern item checking: resolving extern statics/functions, type-checking inherent impl members, and validating trait impl members against resolved trait items. Unlike rust-hir-type-check-implitem.h, it contains the concrete matching, compatibility checks, attribute merging, and projection-type creation logic.
